title: Fixes for Macs that stay online without getting paid work

highlights.title: Gets paid work flowing again after a quiet restart
highlights.detail: If Darkbloom sends a freshly started Mac no paid requests for 10 minutes while its model is in demand, BloomGauge sends it one small test request, which gets it picked up for work again. If that doesn't help, it restarts Darkbloom (at most 3 times a day).

highlights.title: Brings Darkbloom back if a restart leaves it switched off
highlights.detail: When a Darkbloom restart fails halfway and leaves its background service unloaded, BloomGauge loads it again after 90 seconds. A darkbloom stop you ran yourself is left alone.
